effective.basis: TCG release of Dark Revelation Volume 2 (DR2-EN044)

changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card when there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 monster that is removed from play and Special Summon it on your side of the field.
changes.modern_text: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.
changes.summary: Reprint rewording only: 'You can only activate this card when there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 monster that is removed from play' becomes 'You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster'. Same activation condition and same resolution.

changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.
changes.summary: The eligible pool narrowed to your own banished monsters. Both English printings (v0 IOC-044, v1 DR2-EN044) say 'Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field' with no owner restriction, while the implemented modern effect only reaches your side: official/c95194279.lua targets LOCATION_REMOVED with a player range of (tp,0) and its chkc test requires 'chkc:IsControler(tp)'. No English printing carries the narrower wording - the pinned cards.cdb text is flagged 'The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG' - so the chronology of this change is unresolved and no date is asserted.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode
gap.behavioural_impact: In a period format the modern card cannot Special Summon a monster the opponent banished, so era lines that used Dimension Distortion to take a monster removed by Bottomless Trap Hole, D.D. Warrior Lady, Chaos Sorcerer or a Macro Cosmos / Dimensional Fissure lock are impossible.

review.notes: The pinned cards.cdb text matches no lineage version (best match index 1 at ratio 0.4577) because it is an unofficial rendering of the OCG card's functionality; the English lineage stops at DR2-EN044 (2005-10-20). Recorded exactly as observed: the printed TCG text never restricted the banished monster to your own, the shipped implementation does. Chronology left open rather than guessed - no printing, no UDE Card Text Updates entry and no other packet evidence dates the restriction. NEEDS ESCALATION: someone should decide whether the TCG card is governed by the OCG erratum at all, since Konami never reprinted it in English; that decision determines whether GOAT (2005-04-01, v0 text) and Edison (2010-04-24, v1 text) get a custom script or keep the modern one. The v0-to-v1 rewording is cosmetic and dated, so only the undated transition blocks snapshot resolution. This card has no upstream historical or unofficial variant of any kind.
